name: Emperor Wen of Sui
contribution: The founding emperor of the Sui dynasty of China.

checks.lead: Emperor Wen of Sui (隋文帝; 21 July 541 – 13 August 604), personal name Yang Jian (楊堅), childhood name Naluoyan (那羅延), Xianbei name Puliuru Jian (普六茹堅), was the founding emperor of the Sui dynasty of China. As a Buddhist, he encouraged the spread of Buddhism through the state.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
